fields.description: The value held on the employee's leave-class field, spelt exactly as it is stored. For DTC these are A, B and C.
fields.label: Leave Class

fields.description: Days ATTENDED before one credit is earned. A quarter of a 30-day month is 7.5. Periods are periods of attendance, not calendar time.
fields.label: Credit Every (Days Present)

fields.description: What one closed period credits. Class C earns half a day per period.
fields.label: Credit Per Period

fields.description: The most this class can earn in a month, and the figure the cadence is checked against on save. Reached at full attendance.
fields.label: Monthly Cap
